### One local owner per remote ticket (#226)  ·  P1  ·  0 of 7 done  ·  bug 6 / ops 1  ·  → v0.18.0
Two local work items were allowed to point at the same ticket in the external tracker. Every sync then overwrote that ticket with whichever item changed last, and a cancelled duplicate marked a live high-priority ticket as done. Repairing the ticket by hand did not hold. This work makes a ticket refuse a second owner, adds a way to undo a link, and stops sync from touching any ticket that more than one item claims.
